title: eleusine indica var. tristachya
intro: Eleusine indica var. tristachya, commonly known as Finger Millet or African Finger Millet, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae and is native to Africa. It is known for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and help manage diabetes due to its high fiber and nutrient content. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Eleusine indica var. tristachya include ferulic acid, gallic acid, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
